text:
[BEDFIGHT]
[+] Booster (Experimental) runs the Booster kit jetpack through five sub-modules you can use together
[+] Booster InfiniteFuel keeps your jetpack fuel full
[+] Booster FloatBypass taps the jetpack on and off over the void so you hover almost level without being pulled back
[+] Booster NoFallDamage taps the jetpack once just before you land from a fall that would hurt
[+] Booster AntiVoid flies you back up when you fall into the void and hovers until there is ground under you
[+] Booster AntiHit lifts your hitbox out of sword reach and keeps it up with the jetpack instead of touching the ground
[+] LobbyExploit (Experimental) carries your lobby Arrows and Fireballs into the match through your team chest
[+] ChestSteal takes items from team chests you are standing next to
[^] AutoBank has a While rubberbanding option that banks everything the chest takes while the server pulls you back
[^] AutoBank Whitelist only lists items the team chest takes
[^] Fly has a Disable without ground toggle, so it can keep flying when there is no ground to touch
[!] AutoBank While falling, AutoPearl and AutoVoidDrop no longer mistake an ordinary fall for falling into the void
[-] Removed ChestManager, whose looting is now ChestSteal and whose banking is part of AutoBank
[-] Removed InfJetpack, which Booster InfiniteFuel replaces
[GENERAL]
[!] Running ElevateV4 again no longer switches the owner panel off
[!] Usage data keeps one session across a reinject and reports the game you are in from the start
[GUI]
[+] Modules can show sub-modules as collapsible cards, each with its own switch and settings
